description: This Java source file defines an abstract actor class `AbstractBackgroundStreamingActorWithConfigWithStatusReport` used in the Eclipse Ditto framework. The class manages a long-lived streaming process with configurable behavior, including starting, stopping, error handling, logging, and status reporting. It includes abstract methods for parsing configurations and obtaining source streams, signaling that subclasses will implement specific stream logic.

classes.name: AbstractBackgroundStreamingActorWithConfigWithStatusReport
classes.description: Abstract actor that manages long-lived streaming operations with configurable controls, logging, and status reporting within the Eclipse Ditto framework.
